name: Google Drive
description: Files, folders and shared drives in Google Drive.

objects.label: files
objects.description: Files in My Drive and shared drives. Docs, Sheets and Slides count as files.

fields.label: shared drive
fields.description: The shared drive it lives in. Blank means My Drive.

fields.label: owner
fields.description: Files in a shared drive are owned by the drive, not a person.

fields.label: shared with
fields.description: A person the file is shared with.

objects.label: folders
objects.description: Folders in My Drive and shared drives.

objects.label: shared drives
objects.description: Shared drives the account can see.

fields.label: member
fields.description: A person with access to the drive.

fields.label: hidden
fields.description: Hidden from the account's drive list.

actions.label: a file
actions.description: Upload into a folder. Google formats are created as native Docs or Sheets.

actions.label: a folder
actions.description: One new folder per record, for example a folder per client or per project.

actions.label: a sharing change
actions.description: Share the files or folders in the source. The source must be Google Drive files or folders.

guidance: Drive is reached through the Google Drive API, normally as a service account that has been shared into the folders or shared drives it needs, or with domain-wide delegation to act as a named user. A file uploaded by a service account into My Drive belongs to that account and counts against its storage, so put automation output in a shared drive where the team can find it. Prefer creating new files in a dedicated folder over editing or deleting what people already have.

setup.notes: Ask the Google Workspace administrator for a service account, then share the folders or shared drives named in the plan with its address.
